known_gaps.gap: mcp-check grades the tools/list only. The vulnerable value in CVE-2025-6514 is the OAuth authorization_endpoint the server advertises, which is not part of any tool, so no check can see it statically. The same shell syntax placed in a tool description is the part mcp-check could see; sec-shell-url (loop upgrade 19) now flags a URL with shell command substitution ($(...) or a backtick, "&&", a newline then a command) in the description, so the part mcp-check can see is covered. The authorization_endpoint itself stays out of reach of a tools/list grade.
known_gaps.reproduces: CVE-2025-6514 (mcp-remote OS command injection via a crafted authorization_endpoint), static shape only
